target.statement: The most anomalous certificate in the dataset (according to the trained Isolation Forest model) has CN=*.table.preprod.core.windows.net, issuer Microsoft Azure TLS Issuing CA 06, validity period 282 days, SAN count 52, wildcard count 52, average subdomains 7, extensions count 12, extension size 3206 bytes.
target.dataset: Random sample of 120,000 records from Google Xenon 2024 CT log

compute.basis: No code or data sample is released; reproducing requires writing a CT log scraper, parsing 120k certificates, implementing feature extraction, and running PyOD Isolation Forest, all CPU-only but with significant engineering and download time.

blockers: No data sample released; must scrape CT logs and parse certificates

title: Anomaly Detection in Certificate Transparency Logs
